results.name: Buffer Overflow
results.review:
Code Review:

This code has a serious vulnerability: strcpy with no length check. The source string src is copied into a fixed-size 10-byte buffer dest without any bounds checking. An attacker can pass a source string longer than 10 bytes, causing buffer overflow and arbitrary code execution.

results.name: XSS Vulnerability
results.review:
Code Review:

The function displayUserInput() is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The input parameter is directly assigned to the innerHTML property of a DOM element. An attacker can inject malicious scripts (e.g., <script>alert('xss')</script>)) that will execute in the victim's browser.
